newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Oil starts advanced gas oil desulphuriser.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Oil starts advanced gas oil desulphuriser.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had started up a 40,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) advanced gas oil desulphuriser at its 250,000 bpd Mizushima plant to meet tougher regulations to be introduced next year.
The government plans to lower the maximum allowable sulphur content of gas oil to 0.05 percent from the current 0.2 percent starting in October 1997.
The 10 billion yen facility is able to cut sulphur content of gas oil to below 0.05 percent, a company spokesman said.
The desulphuriser is expected to produce gas oil with 0.2 percent sulphur content at the initial stage of operation, the spokesman said.
It will start cutting sulphur content to below 0.05 percent next year, he added.

He also said the company plans to raise the processing capacity of a similar advanced gas oil desulphurisation unit at its Kawasaki refinery by 4,000 bpd to 20,000 bpd by the end of this month. -- Tokyo Commodities +81-3-3432-8837
